wire.description: Incomplete frame discarded after idle interval

wire.description: Host timeout; fail uncertain without automatic retry

wire.description: Initial CRC32 register and final XOR value

status.name: BAD_VALUE
status.description: Range, alignment, profile, or reserved value invalid

status.name: BAD_STATE
status.description: Command not permitted in current state

status.name: BAD_IMAGE
status.description: Incomplete image or whole-image CRC mismatch

status.name: NO_FRAME
status.description: No complete source frame since reset

status.name: STEP_LIMIT
status.description: Budget exhausted; paused without next retirement

trace.name: INTERRUPT
trace.description: Completed interrupt entry; separate event, not instruction retirement

frame.name: BYTES
frame.description: Four shades per byte; first pixel in bits 1:0

command.name: READ_HOST
command.description: Read exactly one aligned host register; unknown addresses fail.

command.name: RESET
command.description: Pause at a dot boundary and initialize direct state; retain valid ROM and profile.

command.name: RUN
command.description: Resume from retained phase; acknowledgement after transition.

command.name: HALT
command.description: Host pause at next dot boundary; already paused is idempotent.

command.name: STEP
command.description: Advance until next completed instruction or the requested dot budget; interrupt entry does not satisfy retirement.

command.name: LOAD_BEGIN
command.description: Validate metadata, pause/reset, invalidate old image and start a fresh load.

command.name: LOAD_WRITE
command.description: Write 1..252 image bytes, marking each byte present; ranges cannot cross image end.

command.name: LOAD_END
command.description: Require every byte written and expected CRC32; reset and mark image valid, paused.

command.name: READ_ROM
command.description: Read exact image storage bytes; host offsets never denote CPU or host registers.

command.name: INPUT
command.description: Apply full button mask at next dot boundary, or immediately while paused; return completed dot count.

command.name: SNAPSHOT
command.description: Copy last completed source frame to dedicated immutable host snapshot; fail if none since core reset.

command.name: READ_FRAME
command.description: Read dedicated snapshot, unchanged until next successful SNAPSHOT or global reset.

command.name: WRITE_HOST
command.description: Write a whitelisted host control register.

command.name: RUN_DOTS
command.description: Run a bounded number of real dots and pause

command.name: PEEK
command.description: Read exact bytes from one paused non-ROM store; read-only, rejected unless paused.

command.name: SDRAM_WRITE
command.description: Write 1 through 15 consecutive 16-byte lines at a line-aligned SDRAM device address; payload 4 + 16 n bytes; requires the SDRAM initialized.

command.name: SDRAM_READ
command.description: Read 1 through 15 consecutive 16-byte lines from a line-aligned SDRAM device address; requires the SDRAM initialized.

peek.name: OAM
peek.description: Object attribute memory peek selector; both halves in byte order

input_source.name: UART
input_source.description: Use the host button mask; reset default.

input_source.name: PHYSICAL
input_source.description: Use the coherent physical button mask.

sdram.name: ADDRESS_BITS
sdram.description: Device byte address width; the DE10-Lite SDRAM holds 64 MiB

sdram.name: LINE_BYTES
sdram.description: One line: the unit of every SDRAM host command

sdram.name: READ_MAX_LINES
sdram.description: Largest SDRAM_READ line count; 15 lines fit one response payload

sdram.name: WRITE_MAX_LINES
sdram.description: Largest SDRAM_WRITE line count; the address and 15 lines fit one request payload

library.name: SLOT_BYTES
library.description: One image slot: a complete 32 KiB image; a 64 KiB MBC1 image occupies two adjacent slots

library.name: SLOTS
library.description: Game slots 0-15

library.name: MENU_INDEX
library.description: Image index of the menu image; the largest selectable index

library.name: CATALOGUE_ENTRIES
library.description: Catalogue entries: sixteen game slots plus the menu

library.name: WINDOW_BYTES
library.description: One banked window: the ROM store upper half

library.name: WINDOW_BANKS
library.description: Window bank register range; bank n is SDRAM bytes n*WINDOW_BYTES onward

library.name: CATALOGUE_ADDRESS
library.description: SDRAM byte address of the catalogue table; window bank 34

library.name: ENTRY_BYTES
library.description: One catalogue entry; the catalogue_entry record lays it out

library.name: CATALOGUE_VALID
library.description: Catalogue valid byte of a selectable entry

library.name: TAGLINE_ADDRESS
library.description: SDRAM byte address of the tagline table, right after the entries in the same 1 KiB catalogue region and the same window bank

library.name: TAGLINE_BYTES
library.description: One tagline record: TAGLINE_CHARS characters then 6 zero bytes; tagline i is at TAGLINE_ADDRESS + TAGLINE_BYTES * i

library.name: TAGLINE_CHARS
library.description: Tagline characters of one record, the width of the menu status plate; an all-zero record is no tagline

library.name: FILL_BOUND_EDGES
library.description: Window fill bound from the bank commit edge to window_busy falling

library.name: SWAP_BOUND_EDGES
library.description: Image swap bound for a 32 KiB image from the accepting select commit edge to copy_busy falling

library.name: SWAP_BOUND_MBC1_EDGES
library.description: Image swap bound for a 64 KiB MBC1 image from the accepting select commit edge to copy_busy falling

library.name: RESULT_NONE
library.description: $A002: no swap since global reset

library.name: RESULT_OK
library.description: $A002: the last swap completed with a matching CRC

library.name: RESULT_INVALID_SLOT
library.description: $A002: the catalogue entry was not a valid image of its profile's length at an index it fits

library.name: RESULT_CRC_MISMATCH
library.description: $A002: the copied bytes did not match the catalogue CRC

library.name: RESULT_NOT_READY
library.description: $A002: a select or bank commit while the SDRAM was not ready

library.name: STATUS_COPY_BUSY
library.description: $A000 bit 7: a window fill or swap is in progress

library.name: STATUS_WINDOW_READY
library.description: $A000 bit 6: the upper half holds the selected bank completely

library.name: STATUS_SDRAM_READY
library.description: $A000 bit 5: the SDRAM controller is initialized and no boot copier runs

library.name: STATUS_KEY1_PENDING
library.description: $A000 bit 4: a KEY1 return waits for the current copy to finish

library.name: STATUS_FLASH_BOOT
library.description: $A000 bit 3: this power-up's library was copied from flash

library.name: CONTROL_RETURN
library.description: WRITE_HOST(LIBRARY_CONTROL) value that requests the menu return

library.name: GAME_EXIT_VALUE
library.description: Direct-profile CPU write value to $6000-$7FFF that requests the menu return; equals MENU_INDEX so both profiles share one select decode

library.name: KEY1_DEBOUNCE_EDGES
library.description: KEY1 level must be stable this many edges (5 ms) before the debounced level changes

library.name: KEY1_HOLD_EDGES
library.description: Debounced KEY1 press length (0.5 s) that raises one menu return

mbc1.name: RESET_BANK

mbc1.name: BANK1_START

mbc1.name: BANK2_START

offset.description: ROM file offset or snapshot byte offset

peek_range.name: offset

dot.name: dot
dot.description: Number of completed emulated dots at transition

retirement.name: seq

retirement.name: pc_before
retirement.description: PC before instruction or interrupt entry

run_dots.name: executed

sdram_write.name: address
sdram_write.description: Line-aligned device byte address of the first line; bits 31:26 and 3:0 zero. Followed by 1 through WRITE_MAX_LINES lines of 16 bytes, byte 0 first; the line count is the payload length minus 4, divided by 16

sdram_read.name: address
sdram_read.description: Line-aligned device byte address; bits 31:26 and 3:0 zero

sdram_read.name: count

catalogue_entry.name: valid
catalogue_entry.description: 1 valid image, 0 empty slot; any other value is invalid

catalogue_entry.name: profile
catalogue_entry.description: Profile ID the image runs in: DIRECT_ID or MBC1_ID for games, LOADER_ID for the menu

catalogue_entry.name: length
catalogue_entry.description: Image length bits 15:0; with length_high the profile's image bytes: 32768 or 65536

catalogue_entry.name: crc32
catalogue_entry.description: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC of the whole image, as LOAD_BEGIN

catalogue_entry.name: length_high
catalogue_entry.description: Image length bits 23:16: 0 for a 32 KiB image, 1 for 64 KiB
